good: Varied track: city boulevard, cliffs with pyramids, a tunnel and a red suspension bridge
Clean Burnout-style HUD: big speed number, boost bar, position, lap, takedowns, minimap and upcoming-turn hints
Trailer shows a TAKEDOWN! card, a drift, boost at over 300 km/h and first place
bad: The automatic checks failed steering and no-auto-steer: with only W held, the car follows the bends
Many crashes against walls during the scripted drive, and the scripted run drops to 8th and stays there
Low-poly flat look with blocky rival cars; speed sense comes mostly from the number on the HUD
opus-5.5-xhigh.one_line: Nice-looking stylized coastal circuit with a slick HUD and a working takedown card, but the car seems to steer itself and the steering checks failed, so it doesn't feel like you're really driving.

good: Strong stylized world: city, cliffs, tunnel and bridge, warm lighting, and a clear Burnout-style HUD with a minimap
The trailer shows a TAKEDOWN! card, a drift label, boost at 300+ km/h and a clean podium run to 1st
Rivals start on a grid around the player, and the road has real bends with corner callouts
bad: Holding only W makes the car drift off the road and hit the wall (CRASHED at 162 and then 26), so there is no auto-steer, but the crashes are frequent and not forgiving
Steering is hard to read: A and D show crashes and scrapes, and the car looks mostly straight with little body roll or sense of turning
The player car is a small boxy teal hatchback and the rivals are low-poly. Speed lines and blur are weak, and the camera sits far back, so the car looks small
sonnet-5.5-xhigh.one_line: It looks good with a nice city-to-bridge track and a punchy HUD, but the car crashes into walls too often and the steering feels vague.

good: Rich Burnout-style HUD: big speed readout, boost bar with %, position, lap, takedown counter, minimap, corner callouts and DRIFT label
Track has real variety and character: city straight, tunnel, coastal cliff road, orange suspension bridge, desert bends with palms/lamps/rocks
Rival pack and takedowns work - big 'TAKEDOWN!' card, counter climbs 00 to 03 in 30 s, no civilian traffic
bad: Car self-steers and holds the lane with only W held (harness noAutoSteer fail) - it follows the road through bends, so the player is not really driving
Steering direction unreliable (steerLeftRight fail): holding A ends with the car crashed against the right-side lamp post, and most turn-in phases end in CRASHED
Flat hazy lighting, unshaded low-poly buildings/rocks and cars with no shadows or textures - the world reads as a stylized mockup, not a Burnout-like place
minimax-m3.1-flash-free.one_line: A tidy low-poly racer with a genuinely good Burnout-style HUD, real track variety and working takedowns, but the car drives itself through the bends, so you are a passenger with a boost button.
